reactor_type: isothermal closed space sublimation and epitaxy
evidence: Between consecutive exposures to the elemental sources, the substrate is exposed for a certain period to the puriﬁed hydrogen environment in order to remove the residual vapors from the substrate cavity to avoid intermixing of vapors of different elements. This time is called purge time. Different sets of purge (3, 10, and 20 s ) and exposure (3, 6, and 10 s ) times were used to evaluate the inﬂuence of the growth parameters in the ICSSE growth of CdTe.
